ranks: Tramplesaurus Rex precon (FDC, commander Ghalta, Primal Hunger): its 24 missing cards, existing vocabulary only

blocked.name: Arachnogenesis
blocked.why: X is 'the number of creatures attacking you' (no filter clause names the defender), and 'prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn by non-Spider creatures' — prevent-all-combat-damage takes no source filter.

blocked.name: Ezuri's Predation
blocked.why: One 4/4 token per creature your opponents control, each fighting a different one of those creatures, simultaneously — nothing pairs created tokens with the objects they were made for.

blocked.name: Pugnacious Hammerskull
blocked.why: Stun counters (rule 122.1d) aren't modeled: nothing replaces untapping with removing one (AUTHORING §15).

blocked.name: Scrapshooter
blocked.why: Gift a card (rule 702.174): an optional additional cost naming an opponent, a gift given on entering, and 'if the gift was promised' — no vocabulary for any of it.

blocked.name: Tangleweave Armor
blocked.why: 'Equipped creature gets +X/+X, where X is the greatest mana value among your commanders' — grantPtPerCount counts permanents/cards; nothing reads the commanders' mana value wherever they are.

blocked.name: Thickest in the Thicket
blocked.why: 'Draw two cards if you control the creature with the greatest power or tied' — source-greatest reads the source's own power (an enchantment), and an opponent-controls filter with an { amount } compare fails closed in a condition.

blocked.name: War Room
blocked.why: 'Pay life equal to the number of colors in your commanders' color identity': an activation cost's payLife is a fixed number.

blocked.name: Challenger Troll
blocked.why: 'Each creature you control with power 4 or greater can't be blocked by more than one creature' — no such CombatRestriction (and its scope reads power).

blocked.name: Collective Resistance
blocked.why: Escalate {G} (rule 702.120): a cost for each mode chosen beyond the first — castModal has no per-extra-mode cost.

blocked.name: Kenrith's Transformation
blocked.why: The enchanted creature loses all abilities and is a green Elk creature (only) with base 3/3: a static can add types and set base P/T, but not set colour, set types/subtypes, or remove abilities (the animate effect can, but only as a one-shot).

blocked.name: Monstrous Onslaught
blocked.why: 'X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control as you cast this spell' — divided.total is a fixed number.

blocked.name: Ram Through
blocked.why: 'If the creature you control has trample, excess damage is dealt to that creature's controller instead' — a one-sided fight has no excess-damage clause.
